status: source-verified; ready for an explicitly labeled 2023 production-share panel

source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
source.publication: World Food and Agriculture – Statistical Yearbook 2025
source.geography: Published Europe regional aggregate; UN M49-based classification. Russian Federation is its whole national statistical area, not European Russia. EU is not the aggregation boundary.
source.coverage_note: The yearbook uses sums/weighted means and publishes aggregates subject to a sufficiency threshold. Published Europe is not proof of an observation for every microstate/territory. Country and reporting-area coverage can differ across domains.

formula: 100 * Europe production / World production for exactly the same commodity and year
